note: S07 + D13/D34. Personalities give worlds texture; every number tune-by-battery.
note_recovery: D51, RETUNED 2026-08-07. A recovery is scored x2 so an operative in custody outranks ordinary work without dominating it. It shipped at x4 and that was a FEEDBACK LOOP: the AI chased recoveries into guarded Holding Sites, got captured there, and each capture generated another high-priority dangerous job. Measured at x4 vs x1 over 24 world-days: burns 28.5 vs 13.5, captures 19.5 vs 4.5, failures 18.0 vs 2.0, completions 8.5 vs 11.5. At x2 recoveries still happen (2 completed of 6 offered across 8 world-days) and the world stays healthy. A priority multiplier on a job that CREATES more of itself needs measuring, not choosing.
note_evac_target: D53. Scales WITH contract rewards, never independently: a deployment should cover 2-3 contracts (D11), so this is roughly 2.5x the average completed reward. Left at 260 after the pay levelling, a single surveillance contract exceeded it and the Firm banked once and went home -- 0.7 minute deployments. Whenever a reward moves, re-measure deployment length and deploysToTier3 together.
note_night: S17/D63a follow-up (2026-08-27): when an area contract's entry decision lands in DAYLIGHT with night no more than waitForNightTicks away, the AI holds at the site door and enters after dark - the 30% watcher-sight cut prices a short wait cheaper than a lit approach. A LONG wait is never taken: contract timers keep running.
